items.title: Enhanced geothermal notches another win as Google buys 400 MW from Fervo

items.title: Google spared from ad-business breakup, but judge orders changes to how it operates
items.feed_excerpt: Google has dodged an effort to break up its ad business, but a judge said Wednesday that the company will need to adjust its business to benefit competitors.

items.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts

items.title: MapQuest is now the No. 1 US app after bucking Trump’s ‘Lake America’ renaming
items.feed_excerpt: The once-dominant mapping app has surged to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store after refusing to adopt Trump’s “Lake America” name, drawing more than half of its 2026 U.S. downloads in just six days.
